adjudication_summary: Source re-review recovered paper-supported antiviral activity/toxicity rows from XML/PDF/Figures 4-6, reconciled linked DBAASP rows, preserved CAMP aggregate conflicts, and found no local supplementary assets to recover. The paper is publication-grade with explicit database cautions, not clean acceptance.
summary: Source re-review recovered HCoV-229E fusion, pseudovirus, live-virus, and cytotoxicity rows for 229E-HR1P/229E-HR2P and preserved unsupported CAMP aggregate claims as conflicts.

canonical_identifiers.title: Peptide-Based Membrane Fusion Inhibitors Targeting HCoV-229E Spike Protein HR1 and HR2 Domains.

materials_exhausted.note: Supplementary assets were exhausted as absent: packet supplementary_index.json, archive_manifest.json, and landed asset_manifest.csv list no supplementary files beyond OA package figures/NXML/PDF.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay rows and literature links match local primary figure/text evidence for peptide identity, citation, antiviral IC50/lower-bound VSV values, and cytotoxicity lower bounds. CAMP aggregate rows remain source_conflict because they mix source-supported HCoV-229E facts with unsupported cross-virus/anticancer text and one HR2 fusion-value mismatch.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repair added 14 source-located rows covering HCoV-229E S cell-cell fusion, VSV G specificity control, HCoV-229E pseudovirus infection, live HCoV-229E replication in Huh-7/A549, and Huh-7/A549 cytotoxicity lower bounds. No MIC-like antimicrobial rows were invented.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 final review keeps mechanism bounded to HR1/HR2 six-helix-bundle interaction and HCoV-229E fusion/infection inhibition. It rejects antibacterial, anticancer, and nucleic-acid mechanism overclaims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Packet material is complete-with-gaps only because no supplementary assets exist locally; the remaining gap is nonblocking after checking XML/PDF/OA figures and database snapshots.

caution_findings.evidence_context: CAMP CAMPSQ23811/CAMPSQ23812 rows contain unsupported SARS-CoV/MERS-CoV/HCoV-NL63/HCoV-OC43 and anticancer text for this primary paper, and HR2P fusion value conflicts with Figure 4b.
The packet database snapshot has no linked_sequence_records. Peptide identity was checked from Results and Figure 2a, but no database sequence string was available for exact sequence comparison.
No supplementary assets are listed in packet supplementary_index.json or landed asset_manifest.csv; no missing supplement values were fabricated.
